facts.label: Basquete no parque
facts.sub: Responda Do you want to play basketball with us? Pergunte Do you need one more player? Sugira Let’s make teams of three. Pergunte How long is the game? e Do you have a ball?

facts.label: Jogos abertos
facts.sub: Pickup significa que qualquer pessoa pode entrar. Chegue à quadra, pergunte se precisam de mais um jogador e espere os times se formarem na hora.

facts.label: Times
facts.sub: Os times costumam ter três ou cinco jogadores. Os capitães escolhem um por vez, e o jogo vai até um número de pontos, como onze.

pages.title: An orange ball · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday afternoon at a busy park in Chicago. Leo walks past an outdoor court. Five men run and laugh with an orange ball. The ball bounces loudly on the ground. One of them stops and waves at Leo. His name is Jay.
“Hey! Do you want to play basketball with us?” says Jay. “Sure! Do you need one more player?” says Leo. “Yes. We have four. Let’s make teams of three.” says Jay.

pages.title: An orange ball · 3/3
paragraphs: “Do you have a ball?” says Leo. “Yes. Take a bottle of water. It is hot today.” says Jay. Leo ties his shoes and joins a team. He passes the ball and makes two baskets.
